dataset: input/sample-03-05: 10 people x 3 fingers x 2 shots, caliper ground truth
notes: Refit for mask edge method (was Sobel in v2). Mask raw measurements over-estimate caliper truth by ~0.11 cm; linear correction reduces MAE by 50.3% in LOO-CV. Coefficients coincidentally close to v2 Sobel values since both methods share similar ~7% projection bias vs caliper. Fit with --no-calibration to avoid double-calibration.
